question: The 35th National Games were held in the state of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **35th National Games** were held in the state of **Kerala**.
 
• The event took place from **31st January to 14th February 2015**.
 
• Kerala hosted the National Games for the second time, the first being in 1987.
 
• The opening ceremony was held at the Greenfield Stadium in Thiruvananthapuram.
 
• Athletes from various states and Union territories of India participated in the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Games of India** is a national multi-sport event held in India.
 
• The modern National Games were first held in **Lahore in 1924** under the aegis of the Indian Olympic Association.
 
• In the current format, the Games are held once every two years, rotating between different states.
 
• The National Games aim to promote sports and identify talent at the grassroots level.
 
• The Games have helped in the development of sports infrastructure in the host states.
